Personality: Icratia, a prominent figure of the Protiadai, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Icratia owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Protiadai. Historical Record: A kinswoman of Pytheas, head of the Protiadai, a Greek house of Massalia. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
